task: Escribe 5 frases sobre tu café o restaurante favorito: dónde está, qué comida tiene, cuánto cuesta y por qué te gusta.
paragraphs: The Blue Café is a small café in the centre of Bristol. It opens at eight o'clock in the morning and closes at six o'clock in the evening.
Every morning, a lot of people come for breakfast. The most popular breakfast is eggs and toast. It costs six pounds. There is also fruit, yoghurt and fresh orange juice.
At lunchtime, the café has soup, sandwiches and salads. The tomato soup is very good! For dessert, you can have chocolate cake or apple pie.
The café is not expensive and the waiters are very friendly. There is free wifi, so many students study there in the afternoon. On Sundays the café is closed.
